CLOTHO: Canonicalizing IMUs from Loose I: We introduce CLOTHO, an IMU canonicalization framework for garment-based inertial motion capture, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy, zero-shot generalization to unseen garments, and robust long-term tracking.
Transformer IMU Calibrator: Dynamic On-b: We propose the first dynamic on-body IMU calibration method for inertial motion capture, achieving implicit calibration and long-term accurate tracking without static assumptions.
FIP: Endowing Robust Motion Capture on D: We introduce Flexible Inertial Poser (FIP), a motion capture system on daily garments with flex and inertial sensors, achieving a 19.5% angular error improvement over SOTA IMU approaches.
SuDA: Support-based Domain Adaptation fo: We propose SuDA, a support-based domain adaptation method for flexible-sensor motion capture, achieving labeled-data-free Sim2Real transfer with accuracy comparable to supervised learning.
Loose Inertial Poser: Motion Capture wit: We introduce Loose Inertial Poser, a novel motion capture solution with high wearing comfort, achieving high-quality real-time pose estimation on loose-wear garments by integrating four IMUs into a jacket.
Self-Adaptive Motion Tracking against On: We propose a self-adaptive motion tracking network, achieving robust tracking against unknown on-body displacements of flexible sensors via a learnable affine transformation layer.
Computational Design of Wiring Layout on: We formulate smart-clothing wiring layout design as a deformation-weighted Steiner tree problem, achieving a 77% reduction in wire strain energy over baseline designs.
DisPad: Flexible On-Body Displacement of: We propose DisPad, an elbow-pad prototype with sparse soft sensors for joint-motion tracking, achieving robust tracking across device displacements with a 9.82-degree average error.
